topic: Wire the tool hooks on this Mac after release
detail: Once a release contains SP-012: run `orch install --target claude-code --apply` and `orch install --target codex --apply` (dry run first), then review and trust the new PreToolUse entry in Codex. `orch status` shows '<harness> tool hooks wired' when done. Until then nothing is logged. Update 2026-11-10 (decision review): orch 0.45.1 is installed and contains SP-012, but orch status shows the tool hooks missing. Dry runs are clean: ~/.claude/settings.json gains PreToolUse and CwdChanged (19 third-party entries kept) and ~/.codex/hooks.json gains PreToolUse (6 kept). The user will run the two --apply commands and trust the Codex entry.
